params.name: api_key
params.description: Your Geocode Earth API key.

params.name: text
params.description: The place or address to search for.

params.name: size
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

params.name: layers
params.description: Comma-separated list of layers to search, e.g. venue, address, street, locality, region, country, or the coarse alias.

params.name: sources
params.description: Comma-separated list of data sources to query, e.g. osm (OpenStreetMap), oa (OpenAddresses), wof (Who's on First), gn (Geonames).

params.name: boundary.country
params.description: Restrict results to one or more ISO 3166-1 country codes.

params.name: boundary.rect.min_lon
params.description: Minimum longitude of a bounding rectangle filter.

params.name: boundary.rect.min_lat
params.description: Minimum latitude of a bounding rectangle filter.

params.name: boundary.rect.max_lon
params.description: Maximum longitude of a bounding rectangle filter.

params.name: boundary.rect.max_lat
params.description: Maximum latitude of a bounding rectangle filter.

params.name: boundary.circle.lat
params.description: Latitude of the center of a bounding circle filter.

params.name: boundary.circle.lon
params.description: Longitude of the center of a bounding circle filter.

params.name: boundary.circle.radius
params.description: Radius of the bounding circle filter, in kilometers.

params.name: focus.point.lat
params.description: Latitude used to prioritize results near a given location.

params.name: focus.point.lon
params.description: Longitude used to prioritize results near a given location.

params.name: lang
params.description: Preferred response language as an ISO 639-1 or 639-3 code, used to localize result labels where translations are available.
